design-system-theme.title: Gen Z Aesthetic
design-system-theme.text: use a bold Gen Z visual system with oversized typography, unusual image crops, stickers, arrows, layered cutouts, playful graphics and intentionally energetic compositions that feel native to contemporary social media

design-system-theme.title: Luxury Minimal
design-system-theme.text: use a refined luxury minimal design system with generous negative space, restrained compositions, sophisticated serif and sans-serif typography, subtle premium details and an elegant high-end fashion mood

design-system-theme.title: Editorial Magazine
design-system-theme.text: create a fashion magazine-inspired layout using editorial columns, strong headlines, refined typography, structured image placement, captions and issue-style compositions

design-system-theme.title: Y2K Fashion
design-system-theme.text: use a Y2K-inspired fashion aesthetic with chrome surfaces, metallic gradients, distorted typography, direct-flash photography, glossy details and futuristic early-2000s nostalgia

design-system-theme.title: Brutalist Design
design-system-theme.text: use a raw brutalist graphic system with rigid grids, oversized typography, stark black and white contrast, exposed layout structures and intentionally unconventional or harsh compositions

design-system-theme.title: Swiss Grid
design-system-theme.text: use a disciplined Swiss modernist design system with strict grids, precise alignment, functional typography, controlled spacing and clean highly organized compositions

design-system-theme.title: Retro 70s
design-system-theme.text: create a 1970s-inspired visual language using warm earthy tones, expressive vintage typography, curved graphic forms, analog film texture and nostalgic fashion editorial styling

design-system-theme.title: 90s Fashion Editorial
design-system-theme.text: use a 1990s fashion editorial aesthetic with direct-flash photography, bold magazine typography, raw studio compositions, candid posing and confident campaign energy

design-system-theme.title: Neo-Futuristic
design-system-theme.text: create a neo-futuristic design system using chrome objects, translucent materials, holographic accents, reflective surfaces, futuristic typography and sleek experimental compositions

design-system-theme.title: Quiet Luxury
design-system-theme.text: use an understated quiet luxury aesthetic with muted sophisticated colors, elegant typography, premium material emphasis, subtle branding and restrained high-end composition

design-system-theme.title: Streetwear Editorial
design-system-theme.text: create a streetwear editorial design with oversized typography, urban textures, dynamic camera angles, layered graphics and a balance of gritty street culture with premium fashion styling

design-system-theme.title: Scrapbook / Collage
design-system-theme.text: use a layered scrapbook collage aesthetic with torn-paper edges, taped photographs, handwritten notes, overlapping imagery, rough textures and intentionally handmade compositions

design-system-theme.title: Product Blueprint
design-system-theme.text: present the product through a technical blueprint-inspired system using diagrams, measurements, arrows, fabric callouts, construction details, labels and structured product annotations

design-system-theme.title: Infographic Fashion
design-system-theme.text: use a clean fashion infographic system combining product imagery with benefit callouts, icons, diagrams, structured information hierarchy and easy-to-understand product education

design-system-theme.title: Monochrome Campaign
design-system-theme.text: build the entire creative around a single dominant color inspired by the garment, using tonal backgrounds, typography, props and styling to create a cohesive monochromatic campaign world

design-system-theme.title: Color Blocking
design-system-theme.text: use bold geometric color blocks, strong contrasting backgrounds and graphic shapes to create energetic compositions while keeping the product visually dominant

design-system-theme.title: Gradient Modern
design-system-theme.text: use a contemporary design system with soft or vibrant gradients, floating typography, subtle depth, smooth graphic transitions and a polished modern ecommerce aesthetic

design-system-theme.title: Typography-First
design-system-theme.text: make typography the primary visual element using oversized campaign headlines, expressive type hierarchy and bold text composition while the model or product acts as supporting imagery

design-system-theme.title: Photography-First
design-system-theme.text: prioritize powerful art-directed fashion photography with minimal text, strong framing, cinematic lighting, expressive posing and visual storytelling driven primarily through imagery

design-system-theme.title: Split-Screen Storytelling
design-system-theme.text: use divided layouts to present two complementary perspectives such as different moods, styling directions, occasions or male and female interpretations within the same visual system

design-system-theme.title: Before / After Styling
design-system-theme.text: structure the creative around a visual transformation from a basic or unstyled outfit into a finished styled look, making the contrast immediately understandable through clear before-and-after composition

design-system-theme.title: Day-in-the-Life
design-system-theme.text: tell a sequential lifestyle story showing the same product across different moments such as morning, work, evening and night to communicate versatility and everyday relevance

design-system-theme.title: POV Carousel
design-system-theme.text: use first-person social-native storytelling built around a relatable POV statement, conversational typography and lifestyle imagery that makes the audience feel personally involved in the scenario

design-system-theme.title: Meme / Internet Culture
design-system-theme.text: use relatable internet culture, fashion humor, screenshot-inspired layouts, chat graphics, reaction-style text and social-native visual language while keeping the product naturally integrated

design-system-theme.title: Pinterest Aesthetic
design-system-theme.text: use a curated Pinterest-inspired visual language with muted tones, aspirational lifestyle photography, elegant spacing, moodboard-style imagery and softly coordinated compositions

design-system-theme.title: High-Fashion Avant-Garde
design-system-theme.text: create a conceptual high-fashion system using unconventional poses, surreal or sculptural props, asymmetric layouts, experimental styling and artistic editorial direction

design-system-theme.title: Soft Minimal / Korean Editorial
design-system-theme.text: use an airy Korean editorial aesthetic with pastel neutrals, soft natural lighting, generous breathing room, delicate typography and understated contemporary fashion styling

design-system-theme.title: Japanese Graphic Design
design-system-theme.text: use a Japanese editorial graphic system with compact grids, vertical typography, bold geometry, dense information placement, asymmetric balance and disciplined visual rhythm

design-system-theme.title: Techwear UI
design-system-theme.text: use a futuristic interface-inspired visual system with HUD elements, coordinates, technical labels, specification tags, grids and digital overlays surrounding the fashion product

design-system-theme.title: Ecommerce Performance Ad
design-system-theme.text: use a conversion-first ecommerce advertising structure with immediate product clarity, strong benefit hierarchy, offer visibility, supporting proof, clear branding and prominent call-to-action messaging

design-system-theme.title: Social Proof Theme
design-system-theme.text: build the creative around customer validation using ratings, reviews, customer quotes, testimonial cards, UGC-style frames and authentic proof elements supporting the product

design-system-theme.title: Lookbook Theme
design-system-theme.text: use a fashion lookbook system presenting multiple outfits, poses or styling combinations through cohesive editorial sequencing, consistent art direction and minimal supporting copy

design-system-theme.title: Wardrobe Guide
design-system-theme.text: create an educational styling guide showing multiple ways to wear the product, recommended pairings, suitable occasions and practical wardrobe combinations

design-system-theme.title: Material Story
design-system-theme.text: focus the visual narrative on fabric and material quality using macro photography, weave details, texture close-ups, folds, tactile lighting and concise material benefit callouts

design-system-theme.title: Craft / Construction Story
design-system-theme.text: show how the garment is engineered or made through construction details, seams or stitchless techniques, finishing, craftsmanship close-ups and quality-focused annotations

design-system-theme.title: Architecture-Inspired
design-system-theme.text: use an architectural visual language with structured layouts, concrete or stone textures, geometric spaces, strong lines, symmetry or intentional asymmetry and fashion integrated into the environment

design-system-theme.title: Museum / Gallery Theme
design-system-theme.text: present the fashion product like an exhibited artwork using clean gallery spaces, exhibition placards, catalog labels, museum-style typography and carefully controlled visual hierarchy

design-system-theme.title: Newspaper Theme
design-system-theme.text: use a newspaper-inspired editorial system with fashion headlines, multi-column layouts, monochrome print textures, clippings, captions and structured journalistic typography

design-system-theme.title: Polaroid Story
design-system-theme.text: tell the campaign through candid Polaroid-style frames, handwritten captions, casual lifestyle moments, layered photographs and nostalgic personal storytelling

design-system-theme.title: Film Contact Sheet
design-system-theme.text: use a photographer contact-sheet aesthetic with multiple sequential campaign frames, film borders, frame numbers, raw shoot moments and a behind-the-scenes editorial feeling

design-system-theme.title: Motion Illusion
design-system-theme.text: create a sense of movement using repeated model cutouts, sequential poses, motion blur, overlapping frames and dynamic directional composition

design-system-theme.title: Surreal Fashion
design-system-theme.text: create an imaginative surreal fashion world with oversized objects, floating elements, impossible environments, unexpected scale relationships and dreamlike editorial art direction

design-system-theme.title: Minimal Product Poster
design-system-theme.text: use a poster-style composition centered around one strong product or model image, a bold campaign slogan, minimal supporting information and a clear memorable visual hierarchy

design-system-theme.title: Luxury Catalog
design-system-theme.text: use a sophisticated catalog system with refined product photography, clean SKU-style labeling, premium typography, carefully organized product details and elevated ecommerce presentation

design-system-theme.title: Editorial Q&A
design-system-theme.text: structure the creative like a fashion interview using questions and concise answers from the perspective of the product, model or wearer, combined with magazine-inspired editorial photography

design-system-theme.title: Problem → Solution
design-system-theme.text: use a clear problem-to-solution narrative that introduces a relevant clothing discomfort, styling challenge or customer pain point and then demonstrates how the product addresses it

design-system-theme.title: Myth vs Reality
design-system-theme.text: use a myth-versus-reality comparison format to challenge assumptions about fabric, fit, comfort, quality or styling while communicating factual product benefits clearly

design-system-theme.title: Choose Your Look
design-system-theme.text: present two or more distinct styling directions for the same product and invite the audience to compare or choose their preferred outfit, mood or fashion personality

design-system-theme.title: Interactive Swipe Game
design-system-theme.text: turn the creative into a social-native interactive experience using prompts such as swipe to style, pick your fit or choose your favorite, supported by progressive reveals and playful visual cues

design-system-theme.title: Cinematic Storyboard
design-system-theme.text: design each frame like a scene from a short fashion film using cinematic composition, sequential visual storytelling, varied shot sizes, expressive poses and consistent mood across the full sequence
